scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @ai-caller/web
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @ai-caller/server
scripts.check: npm run build:shared && npm run check -w @ai-caller/server
scripts.smoke: npm run build:shared && npm run smoke -w @ai-caller/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @ai-caller/server && npm run typecheck -w @ai-caller/web
